# Media Assets

This directory contains visual assets for the GitHub repository README.

## Files Needed

### Screenshots
- `gameplay.png` - Main gameplay showing dual-plane mechanics
- `leaderboard.png` - Leaderboard interface
- `player-stats.png` - Player statistics panel
- `challenge-mode.png` - Challenge mode in action
- `wallet-connect.png` - Wallet connection flow

### GIFs/Videos
- `gameplay.gif` - Animated gameplay demonstration (recommended: 10-15 seconds)
- `phase-shift.gif` - Phase shift mechanic showcase
- `dash-system.gif` - Dash and coin collection
- `power-ups.gif` - Power-ups in action

### Banner
- `banner.png` - Main hero image (1280x640px recommended)

## How to Add Media

1. **Screenshots**: Play the game and capture screenshots
   - Press `F12` in browser → `Ctrl+Shift+P` → "Capture screenshot"
   - Or use Windows `Win+Shift+S` for quick capture

2. **GIFs**: Record gameplay and convert to GIF
   - Use [ScreenToGif](https://www.screentogif.com/) (Windows)
   - Use [Kap](https://getkap.co/) (Mac)
   - Or [Gifski](https://gif.ski/) for high-quality conversion

3. **Optimize**: Compress media files
   - Use [TinyPNG](https://tinypng.com/) for images
   - Use [Gifski](https://gif.ski/) or [Ezgif](https://ezgif.com/optimize) for GIFs
   - Keep GIFs under 5MB for GitHub

4. **Add to repo**: 
   ```bash
   git add .github/media/gameplay.gif
   git commit -m "docs: Add gameplay GIF"
   git push
   ```

5. **Update README**: The placeholders are already in place, just need the actual files!

## Tips

- Keep GIFs short (10-15 seconds)
- Use 1280x720 or 1920x1080 resolution
- Optimize file sizes (GIFs should be < 5MB)
- Show the most impressive/unique features
- Include UI/blockchain interactions
